notes: B-103's damage side (per dealer stays per dealer). Printed: '{1}{R}, {T}, Discard your hand: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control with power 2 or less deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.' 'A creature ... deals combat damage' is one occurrence per creature (CR 603.2c, no once_per_event), so the Bear and the Cub, connecting in the same combat damage step, draw a card each; the Ox (power 3) draws none. The hand goes 0 -> 2 and seat 1 takes 2 + 1 + 3 (20 -> 14). Read once per step, the trigger would draw one card: this pack kills G3's 'each occurrence -> once per event' mutant.
